Spencer1995.title: Asymptotic Packing via a Branching Process
Spencer1995.checked_content: Poisson branching f'=-f^(Q+1), f=(1+Qc)^(-1/Q). The discrete comparison fixes c and takes D to infinity; it is not the finite-D omitted-parent law.

BalBennett2023.title: The Matching Process and Independent Process in Random Regular Graphs and Hypergraphs
BalBennett2023.checked_locator: Corollary 3, page 3; Corollary 4, page 4 (at r=3, both require D>=3); D=2 is covered by Theorem 2, page 3, and its value is listed in Table 1, page 21
BalBennett2023.scope: Fixed-degree random regular hypergraphs, and a stated high-girth extension. At r=3, Corollaries 3-4 require D>=3; the D=2 numerical comparison uses Table 1 (or Theorem 2), not those corollaries. This is not an exact identity for an arbitrary finite hypergraph's greedy process.
BalBennett2023.novelty: The cavity terminal constant is already published. Its time-dependent formula and correction here are supplementary consequences of the supplied paper's exact independent-unfolding products.
